content: Pedikeredi kara berbet, e no merbim dikeredi mi able tonar dakairtare nalu meriba witwit idoni laglag dali.
Ese wa waba adud akepwar irmirlare waba lamar ia weumi; ese wa no Lamar Zogo asorlare a waba adud tonar dikairtare waba lamar ia idid waurder.
Able le Agudi Lamaride daratkimwarteda Agudira omaskir uridli.
Able Lamar Zogo wa erpeidarda nole wabi dikerda geumgeum atriatri le berda; nolekar, e wabi dikerda Agudira omaskir berda. Abi Lamar Zogo sasrimge mi Agudim ererbakrili: “Baba kara Bab!”
Lamar Zogo a meriba lamar okakise merbi detagreda paretkak mimi uridli Agudira omaskir.
Mimi uridli Agudira omaskir a mi ia mi tarperare Kerisora werkab abi doge. Mi ia Kerisora zorom nabagarare ableglam mi asiasi digieda mokakalam ge e diger.
Kari doge dikeridi mi asi digieda pe mi able gergerge no kebi kakale nagriwerteda ia able zorom merbim waike paretkak.
Gair lu Agudi detagem dikaireda erkep iskeda Agudim e tabara omaskir wanatomertare.

Gair lu Agudi detagem bakeri atutirkak berda Agudi ubilam, nole tabalam. Agudide ko detaut gair lu Agudi detagem ia debele wanagri semersemerlam, a wi ia amisirkak waurder mokakalam Agudira omaskir ia amisirkak waurder.
Mimi umele gair lu Agudi detagem asiasi digilare mena able kerker pe irdi mokakalam koskir werem aosmerge wadawer.

A nole tebteb gair lu Agudi detagem; mimi netiba Lamar Zogo daragriwerteda (able kikem Agudira bodomalam merbim) mi ko mi merbibu moketmir digareda nawar mi dikaireda Agudide merbi kemerkemer waditakrare tabara omaskir a meriba gem waikai amisirkak obai.
